prompt: A playground scene with two children, an older boy in a red shirt and a younger girl. The boy is pushing the girl on a swing. The girl is holding a blue balloon. Behind the swing set, there is a tall oak tree with a tire swing hanging from it. A golden retriever is running toward the children, carrying a stick in its mouth. The boy is taller than the dog. On the ground next to the swing set, there are two books and several toy cars scattered around; the number of toy cars is three more than the number of books. A sandbox sits in front of the tree, with a red bucket inside it. The bucket contains sand and a small shovel. The boy is pointing at a colorful kite flying above the tree. A weathered park bench is positioned behind the sandbox, looking older than the freshly painted swing set. Next to the park bench, some yellow flowers are growing; the number of flowers is double the number of children.
